main_measure.name: abs(forecast)-weighted mean short-side next-day excess move

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 case-days; reject: < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, breaks of 2+ down days minus breaks of 1

decided_by: Main measure positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 case-days and the supporting difference below 0.
reading: Falling calm is taken as the detector's 'unknown' (not vetoed) regime on each bar, both for the situation check and for the supporting check's profile (the 60-bar trend and 365-bar vol percentile cannot be rebuilt inside a window), run lengths are rebuilt from window closes with single-day breaks kept only when the run's start is seen, the t clusters weighted deviations by calendar day with a G/(G-1) correction, and case-days are the distinct days with a short forecast.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.002493 on the check folds against +0.006286 on every fold
